items.title: Community Events
items.content: Potlucks, games, and community building events in our cul-de-sac. We will have quarterly events to help us get to know each other better!

items.title: HOA Meetings
items.content: Periodic messages, voting, and financials are discussed. Please join us in making decisions and improving our neighborhood.

items.title: Working Together
items.content: Many hands make light work. Our goal is to help each other by embracing a spirit of kindness, love, and mutual respect.

items.title: Newsletters
items.content: Get information about the neighborhood, events, and socials. Stay informed and feel free to present your ideas.
